nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $N$, let $P_{kN}$ be the proportion of the assignments giving each of $N$ people exactly $k$ friends other than themselves that connect all $N$ people. Then $P_{kN} \to 1$ as $N \to \infty$ for every $k \ge 2$, and $P_{1N} \to 0$ as $N \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Connectivity threshold for random $k$-out friendship graphs

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $k$ and $N$, $P_{kN}$ is the number of assignments that give each of $N$ people a set of exactly $k$ friends other than themselves and connect all $N$ people, divided by the number of all assignments that give each person a set of exactly $k$ friends other than themselves. When there is no such assignment, $P_{kN} = 0$.
nodes.title: Probability that a random $k$-out assignment connects everyone

nodes.summary: Let $c$ assign to each person $i$ among $N$ people a set $c(i)$ of people, the friends of $i$. The assignment $c$ connects all $N$ people when, for all people $a$ and $b$, there are $m \ge 0$ and people $p_0 = a, p_1, \dots, p_m = b$ such that for each $j < m$, $p_j$ is a friend of $p_{j+1}$ or $p_{j+1}$ is a friend of $p_j$.
nodes.title: Assignments that connect everyone

nodes.summary: Let $c$ assign to each person $i$ among $N$ people a set $c(i)$ of people, the friends of $i$. A person $b$ is reachable from a person $a$ if there are $m \ge 0$ and people $p_0 = a, p_1, \dots, p_m = b$ such that for each $j < m$, $p_j$ is a friend of $p_{j+1}$ or $p_{j+1}$ is a friend of $p_j$.
nodes.title: Reachability by a chain of friends

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
